Corollary
[Hyperbolic lower bound] \group gromov-invariant ↗ thurston-ch06-simplex-volume-bound Source: thurston:page-0139

Every closed oriented hyperbolic $n$-manifold with $n>1$ satisfies \[ \| [M]\| \geq rac{v(M)}{v_n}. \] More generally, if $0 eq \alpha \in H_k(M;\mathbb R)$ with $k eq 1$, and a multiple $\lambda \alpha $ is represented by a $k$-form of pointwise norm at most $1$, then $\| \alpha \| \geq \lambda /v_k$.
